question: In the case where what one eats changes one's bowels. Her favorite would be a person who mostly eats what?
answer: What would be good for the bowels, indeed. I have a mental image that the organs of a vegetarian might be nicer than someone who eats meat, but it seems like someone who just eats fruit might be more beautiful, too. I can't say for sure. In the end, someone who lives well would be better; a modern Japanese person who doesn't live in too much luxury... Subaru will die!
